resolved: 1 critical -- agent:progress published absolute filesystem paths to the renderer; withoutFilesystemPaths in paths.ts now reduces every path in a progress line to root-relative or basename, and tests/integration/agent-progress.test.ts proves it over the real recorded transcript
2 major -- the materialised wiki survived switching agents off; agent:enable{false} now awaits view.remove(), asserted in agent-channels.test.ts by running a real pass and then switching off

3 major -- agent:accept TOCTOU minted two documents on a double accept; LibrarianService.accept shares the in-flight promise per proposal id. The test holds both writers on a gate in the real window rather than racing them, because as a plain race it reproduced only 3 times in 6

4 major -- "one pass at a time" was decided by runner.busy, which only goes true at the spawn, leaving the whole of materialise() unguarded; LibrarianService owns the flag now and both the agent:run guard and decidePass read it

5 major -- no test had the spawned child attempt an escape; fake-claude now tries to write into every --add-dir root and records the errno, and the A02 test asserts the kernel refused every one. ENOENT is deliberately not an accepted code

6 major -- A13 passed because harvest missed the recorded run's file, not because nothing was found; the pass is now genuinely quiet (WR_FAKE_CLAUDE_QUIET) and asserts no markdown the child wrote is left anywhere in the run directory

7 major -- the write/harvest seam is covered end to end: the child writes to ./proposals/ relative to its own cwd, the real ProposalReader finds it, and the recorded argv is asserted to contain the ./proposals/ instruction so both ends of the seam are production code

resolved: 1 major -- a routine zotero:import fell back to the remembered import scope, which made it a *scoped* run, which lifted every removal inside those collections. The plain Import button silently undid curation. Fixed with ScopeOrigin ('named' vs 'remembered'): only a collection named in this action lifts a removal. The old test passed only because its fixture never wrote zotero.importScope

2 major -- the restore path enqueued an index-fts job and nothing has ever drained one (the only consumer claims extract-text), so a restored document and ALL its annotations stayed unfindable forever. [B01] asserted the queued row, so 'queued' and 'never done' had the same observable. Fixed with SearchIndexer.reindexDocument + a pipeline drain for index-fts + the local-file restore path enqueuing too

3 major -- card art checked its one-host allow-list on the first hop only and passed redirect:'follow'. artUrl asks for format=image, which Scryfall answers WITH a redirect, so an unchecked hop was the normal path and the bytes came from an undisclosed host. Fixed by following redirects by hand with the allow-list on every hop (scheme and port included, bounded at 3), and naming cards.scryfall.io in the disclosure, README.md and docs/SECURITY.md
